moments.title: Strictly's Glitterball Return
moments.blurb: The 24th series of Strictly Come Dancing kicks off with its star-studded launch show this Saturday, introducing new hosts Emma Willis, Josh Widdicombe, and Johannes Radebe.

angles.name: New Hosts, New Moves
angles.copy: Get ready for sequins, drama, and a brand new presenting trio! Strictly Come Dancing launches this Saturday with Emma Willis, Josh Widdicombe, and Johannes Radebe taking the reins. Who are you rooting for already?

angles.name: Saturday Night Sorted
angles.copy: Your Saturday nights are officially sorted! The Strictly Come Dancing launch show is tomorrow, unveiling the celebrity pairings for a brand new season of ballroom battles. Time to clear your diary!

moments.title: Bake Off's New Recipe
moments.blurb: The Great British Bake Off returns for its 17th series on Tuesday, September 22nd, with a fresh face in the tent as Nigella Lawson joins Paul Hollywood as a new judge.

angles.name: New Judge Alert
angles.copy: The tent is back! The Great British Bake Off returns Tuesday with a brand new judge alongside Paul Hollywood – the iconic Nigella Lawson! Get ready for some delicious critiques.

angles.name: Cake Week Countdown
angles.copy: Dust off your aprons, Bake Off is back! Cake Week kicks off the new series on Tuesday evening. What's your go-to bake to impress the judges?

moments.title: Premier League Weekend
moments.blurb: A full slate of Premier League action kicks off this weekend, with Tottenham facing Aston Villa tomorrow and Manchester United travelling to Fulham on Sunday.

angles.name: Football's Back
angles.copy: Premier League returns tomorrow! Tottenham vs Aston Villa gets us started, before a packed Saturday of action. Who are you backing for the win this weekend?

angles.name: Sunday Showdowns
angles.copy: Sunday brings more Premier League drama! Liverpool are away at Bournemouth, while Man Utd head to Fulham. Big points up for grabs!

moments.title: Gallagher Prem Rugby Starts
moments.blurb: The Gallagher Premiership Rugby season officially kicks off next Friday, September 25th, with Harlequins hosting Bath and defending champions Northampton Saints taking on Newcastle Red Bulls.

angles.name: Rugby's Return
angles.copy: Get ready for the roar! The Gallagher Premiership season starts next Friday. Who's your pick for the title this year?

angles.name: Exeter Chiefs Season Opener
angles.copy: Sandy Park will be rocking! Exeter Chiefs kick off their Gallagher Premiership campaign next Saturday against Gloucester. Are you ready, Chiefs fans?

moments.title: Autumn Equinox
moments.blurb: Astronomical autumn officially begins next Wednesday, September 23rd, at 1:06 AM BST, marking the Autumn Equinox.

angles.name: Hello Autumn
angles.copy: The season officially changes next Wednesday! The Autumn Equinox signals the start of astronomical autumn. Time for cosy jumpers and pumpkin spice everything?

angles.name: Longer Nights Ahead
angles.copy: As the Autumn Equinox approaches next week, prepare for those darker evenings and crisp mornings. What's your favourite thing about autumn?

moments.title: Official Singles Chart Top 40
moments.blurb: The Official UK Singles Chart is updated today, with Sienna Spiro's 'Great Expectation' currently holding the coveted #1 spot.

angles.name: New Number One!
angles.copy: It's official: Sienna Spiro's 'Great Expectation' is your new UK Number One! What a track. Are you loving it?

angles.name: Chart Movers
angles.copy: The latest Official Singles Chart is in! Beyond the Number 1, we've seen big moves from Ella Langley and a chart resurgence for Dua Lipa. What's on your playlist right now?

moments.title: Happy Birthday Ricky Bell
moments.blurb: Today, September 18th, marks the 59th birthday of Ricky Bell, a founding member of legendary R&B groups New Edition and Bell Biv DeVoe.

angles.name: Poison's Birthday Boy
angles.copy: Happy 59th Birthday to Ricky Bell! From New Edition to Bell Biv DeVoe, he's given us so many R&B classics. What's your favourite track?

angles.name: New Edition Legend
angles.copy: Celebrating Ricky Bell's birthday today! A true icon of R&B. Get 'Poison' on loud!

moments.title: Happy Birthday Joanne Catherall
moments.blurb: Joanne Catherall, one of the iconic vocalists of synth-pop pioneers The Human League, celebrates her 64th birthday today, September 18th.

angles.name: Don't You Want Her Birthday?
angles.copy: Happy 64th Birthday to Joanne Catherall from The Human League! Still sounding incredible. What's your favourite Human League track?

angles.name: Synth-Pop Icon
angles.copy: Celebrating Joanne Catherall's birthday today! An essential voice of the 80s. Turn up The Human League!

moments.title: Happy Birthday Nile Rodgers
moments.blurb: Guitar legend, songwriter, and producer Nile Rodgers, co-founder of Chic and responsible for countless hits, turns 74 tomorrow, September 19th.

angles.name: Good Times & Birthdays
angles.copy: Get ready to groove! Tomorrow is Nile Rodgers' 74th birthday. A true music icon who has shaped generations of sound. What's your favourite Chic track or Nile-produced hit?

angles.name: Disco King's Birthday Eve
angles.copy: From 'Le Freak' to 'Get Lucky', Nile Rodgers is a legend. Wishing him an early Happy 74th Birthday for tomorrow!

moments.title: Happy Birthday David Coverdale
moments.blurb: Rock icon David Coverdale, frontman of Whitesnake and former Deep Purple vocalist, celebrates his 75th birthday on Tuesday, September 22nd.

angles.name: Here I Go Again on My Own
angles.copy: Rock 'n' roll royalty! David Coverdale of Whitesnake and Deep Purple turns 75 on Tuesday. What's your ultimate power ballad from him?

angles.name: Whitesnake Legend
angles.copy: Wishing a future Happy 75th Birthday to the incredible David Coverdale! Still got that voice. What's your favourite Whitesnake track?

moments.title: Happy Birthday Bruce Springsteen
moments.blurb: The Boss, rock legend Bruce Springsteen, will celebrate his 77th birthday next Wednesday, September 23rd.

angles.name: The Boss Turns 77
angles.copy: Next Wednesday, we're celebrating the 77th birthday of rock icon Bruce Springsteen! What's your all-time favourite song from The Boss?

angles.name: Born In The USA & On Tour
angles.copy: Happy Birthday to Bruce Springsteen next week! Still filling stadiums and delivering epic performances. What's his best album?
